reviewFindings: minor: daemon.rs:521-540,809-811 - rejected Insert records false ChangeEvent + generation bump (ADR-0012; fix: record only on success like DocumentEdit path)
minor: edit.rs no-op deletes + editor.rs:319-337 + daemon.rs:815-850 - Backspace at doc start marks dirty, bumps gen, pushes empty undo entry + bogus Delete event
minor: render.rs:216-268 - disk_changed/generation never displayed; external-change clobber by Save is invisible to user
minor: daemon.rs:908-912 - SetViewport stores height without re-scroll; cursor off-screen first frame on short terminals/resize
minor: session.rs:30-70 vs client.rs:91 - session exec Open sends relative paths unresolvable against daemon cwd (wrong-file risk)
minor: client.rs:180-186 - daemon death surfaces as misleading 'invalid response'; no reconnect
minor: keymap.rs:256-261 - AltGr/Compose-modified printable chars cannot be inserted in Insert mode
minor: daemon.rs:891-895 - Goto in Select mode collapses selection instead of extending (vim convention divergence)
minor: client.rs:142-147 - Ctrl-C quits entire TUI in Insert mode (UX; no data loss - daemon persists)
childReport.manualNotes: Supervisor must run: cargo test -p mina-term, cargo check --workspace, and gh issue view 2 3 6 7 8 9 (issue bodies were required evidence I could not fetch without a shell). All 9 findings are MINOR; no CRITICAL/MAJOR. The two strongest fixes: skip event/generation recording when an operation was rejected or was a text no-op (Findings 1-2), and surface disk_changed in the status line (Finding 3).
